description: This file defines a PHP class `LeaveTypeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportData` that implements report data retrieval logic for a leave entitlement usage report within an HR management system. It fetches employee leave data, formats it, and provides metadata for reporting purposes.

classes.name: LeaveTypeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportData
classes.description: A class responsible for gathering and normalizing leave entitlement usage data for reporting purposes, specific to leave types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the report data object with filter parameters.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Generates a normalized array of employee leave entitlement usage data based on the filter parameters.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns metadata about the report, such as total count and leave type information.

methods.name: getNormalizedLeaveType
methods.description: Retrieves and normalizes the leave type details given its ID.
